title: 第八章 临界第七章 万有引力请阁下赴死
lines: 章节摘要：“痛觉是生物的保护机制。她有痛觉，说明她在进化。“——牛顿
宁修远是在管道出口处接住她的。
她自己关机的。
不是被打倒，是她主动触发了紧急停机——在核心温度到达某个数值的前一秒，她把自己关掉了，像一台知道自己快要着火的机器，在燃烧之前，选择了先停止运转。
她倒下来的时候，宁修远刚好在出口等着，伸手接住了她，但她的重量超过他的预期，两人一起跌坐在废土的地面上。
她的胸口没有光了。
能源核心完全熄灭。
宁修远抱着她，后背靠在管道口的铁壁上，没有动。
远处，金丹中期猎人的能量反应在废土地面上缓慢移动，扫了一圈，然后收走了——不是被击退，是撤退。主动的，有目的的撤退。
“为什么走了？“宁修远在心里问牛顿。
“命令变了。“牛顿的声音很短，“原来的命令应该是清除，现在改成了捕获。“
“谁改的？“
“不知道。“牛顿停了一下，“但能在战场上实时更改金丹修士任务的，在天道院里，不会超过三个人。“
宁修远没有继续问。
他低头看着叶清欢的脸。
她的仿生皮肤在极端高温之后有轻微的形变，右侧颧骨的位置出现了一道细细的裂纹，里面露出一点金属骨架的颜色。眼睛闭着，机械触须全部垂落，像是一棵在风里折断了的树。
宁修远把她的头轻轻放正。
“能救吗？“
牛顿沉默了比平时更长的时间。
“带她回去，先扫描。“
安全屋的医疗室里，阿琳把叶清欢放上检查台，连上诊断线，看着屏幕上的数据，吹了声口哨，语气里没有任何好消息的成分：
“核心温度，关机前是2983°c。“
她把屏幕转向宁修远。
[叶清欢·聚变核心·当前状态：紧急停机]
[关机前温度：2983°c]
[冷却至可重启温度：约4小时]
[注意：下次启动后，若功率需求超过当前限制，核心将在激活后23秒内自毁]
宁修远看着那行“23秒“，没有说话。
牛顿开口，声音里没有平时的嘲讽，就是叙述：
“圣女系列的核心，出厂时被植入了限功率芯片。设计上限是真实功率的40%。“
“她这段时间每次全力战斗，用的都是超限功率。每用一次，就在吃安全余量。“
宁修远算了一下，从第二章救叶清欢开始，她全力战斗过多少次——
“她知道吗？“
“知道。“牛顿停了一下，“她的系统一直在提示，只是她没有告诉你。“
宁修远盯着检查台上叶清欢的脸，盯了很久。
“怎么解？“
“移除限功率芯片。“牛顿说，“芯片连接在核心的一级调控回路上，物理取出，剪断连接线。“
“然后呢？“
“然后她的核心就没有功率上限了。“
“问题是什么？“

Chapter summary: "Pain is a protective mechanism of living things. She has pain, which means she is evolving." - Newton
Ning Xiuyuan caught her at the exit of the pipeline.
She turned it off herself.
It was not that she was knocked down, but that she actively triggered the emergency shutdown - she turned herself off one second before the core temperature reached a certain value, like a machine that knew it was about to catch fire, and chose to stop running before burning.
When she fell, Ning Xiuyuan was waiting at the exit and reached out to catch her, but her weight was beyond his expectation, and they both fell to the ground in the wasteland.
Her chest was bare.
The energy core is completely extinguished.
Ning Xiuyuan hugged her and leaned his back against the iron wall of the pipeline entrance without moving.
In the distance, the energy reaction of the middle-stage Golden Core hunter moved slowly on the wasteland, swept in a circle, and then took it away - not being repulsed, but retreating. Active, purposeful retreat.
"Why did you leave?" Ning Xiuyuan asked Newton in his heart.
"The order has changed." Newton's voice was short, "The original order should have been to clear, but now it has been changed to capture."
"Who changed it?"
"I don't know." Newton paused, "But there are no more than three people in the Tiandao Temple who can change the mission of the Golden elixir monks in real time on the battlefield."
Ning Xiuyuan did not continue to ask.
He looked down at Ye Qinghuan's face.
Her bionic skin deformed slightly after the extreme high temperature, and a thin crack appeared on the right cheekbone, revealing a bit of the color of the metal skeleton. With his eyes closed, all the mechanical tentacles drooped down, like a tree broken in the wind.
Ning Xiuyuan gently put her head straight.
"Can it be saved?"
Newton was silent for longer than usual.
"Take her back and scan her first."
In the medical room of the safe house, Arlene put Ye Qinghuan on the examination table, connected the diagnostic line, looked at the data on the screen, and whistled, without any good news in her tone:
"Core temperature, before shutdown, was 2983°C."
She turned the screen to Ning Xiuyuan.
[Ye Qinghuan·Fusion Core·Current Status: Emergency Shutdown]
[Temperature before shutdown: 2983°c]
[Critical value: 3000°c]
[Safety margin: 0.57%]
[Cool down to restartable temperature: about 4 hours]
[Note: After the next startup, if the power demand exceeds the current limit, the core will self-destruct within 23 seconds after activation]
Ning Xiuyuan looked at the line "23 seconds" and said nothing.
When Newton spoke, there was no usual sarcasm in his voice, it was just narration:
"The core of the Saint Lady series is implanted with a power-limiting chip when it leaves the factory. The design upper limit is 40% of the real power."
"Every time she fought with all her strength during this period, she used super-limited power. Every time she used it, she was eating up the safety margin."
Ning Xiuyuan calculated how many times she had fought with all her strength since she rescued Ye Qinghuan in Chapter 2——
"Does she know?"
"I know." Newton paused, "Her system has been prompting, but she didn't tell you."
Ning Xiuyuan stared at Ye Qinghuan's face on the examination table for a long time.
"How to solve it?"
"Remove the power-limiting chip." Newton said, "The chip is connected to the core's primary control loop, physically remove it, and cut off the connecting wire."
"Then what?"
"Then her core has no power cap."
"What's the problem?"
